cases.name: concrete_stable_process
cases.source_pattern: The same visible process rises, changes, and returns across sections.
cases.reason: A concretely recognizable process can require stable representation.

cases.name: repeated_symbolic_meaning
cases.source_pattern: A repeated symbolic image carries the same non-literal meaning in different forms.
cases.reason: Symbolic continuity, not subject identity, is the recurring need.

cases.name: abstract_condition_without_visual_continuity
cases.source_pattern: An abstract condition recurs as explanation but has no stable subject or symbolic visual pattern.
cases.reason: Recurrence and importance do not create a stable visual state.
